required_acceptance: On Validation must match every stored target prediction and time loss within the fixed tolerance, in addition to six aggregate metrics and exact target identity.

Off must retain original shape/mask/nonfinite validation; only the V residual becomes zero. Restore the original function reference in finally. Never mutate parameter tensors or save a modified checkpoint.
Use separate fresh processes for on/off with identical eval mode, batch policy and initial memory state; verify parameters, all buffers and context state before and after each condition.
interpretation: This isolates the direct fixed-checkpoint sensitivity to the V residual with jointly trained weights held fixed. It does not identify the effect of retraining without V or fully separate joint-training causes. Off is not an original CNN baseline.
